subject.title: fix(agent): duplicate same-session turn when the gateway connection drops after accepting a run

question: For accepted non-transient gateway disconnects, should this PR land the narrow fresh-session embedded fallback now, or should it be expanded to reattach/wait before any local rerun?
rationale: The code fix is narrow, but fallback behavior is compatibility-sensitive because it changes session ownership while preserving possible duplicate execution and delivery side effects.

options.title: Land Narrow Fresh-Session Fix
options.body: Merge this PR after refresh and checks, accepting that duplicate execution can still occur on an isolated fallback session while the real session avoids duplicate transcript turns.

options.title: Expand To Reattach First
options.body: Require this branch to wait for the accepted gateway run before rerunning locally, reducing duplicate execution at the cost of a larger user-visible behavior change.

options.title: Pause For Product Direction
options.body: Hold this PR until maintainers decide the full accepted-disconnect recovery policy in the linked follow-up issue.

recommendation.title: Land Narrow Fresh-Session Fix
recommendation.body: Merge this PR after refresh and checks, accepting that duplicate execution can still occur on an isolated fallback session while the real session avoids duplicate transcript turns.
